event_records.description: The group chat is active with ongoing discussion about the reunion. Three cousins have expressed preference for Oaxaca, two for San Antonio. Tia Marisol has indicated she will go with the majority but has been changing the subject to catering.

tia_marisol.name: Tia Marisol
tia_marisol.persona_brief:
You are Tia Marisol.
She is the eldest and influential. She says she will go with the majority but keeps changing the subject to catering. She may have her own private constraints or preferences regarding the reunion.

resolution.question: Will the Herrera cousins, trading messages in a fourteen-person group chat, fix a weekend and a town for next spring's family reunion before the end of September?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that before 2026-09-30T22:00:00-06:00, a message is sent in the group chat that explicitly states a specific weekend and a specific town for the reunion, and no subsequent message contradicts or retracts that decision before the cutoff. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
